claim: 缓存失效导致的额外P99延迟贡献 ΔT_cache_miss = (1-H) * (T_origin - T_hit)；若 H=0.845, T_origin=200ms, T_hit=50ms，则 ΔT_cache_miss = 0.155 * 150ms = 23.25ms，需计入P99延迟预算。
